AWAKENED-SPELLBOOK_FTUE.title: The Spellbook
AWAKENED-SPELLBOOK_FTUE.description:
Your [gold]Spellbook[/gold] holds a fixed set of Spell cards. Any [gold]Conjure[/gold] effect puts the next one into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Once they've all been [gold]Conjured[/gold], it refills with the same Spells. Hover over it to see what's next.
AWAKENED-AWAKEN_FTUE.title: The Awaken Meter
AWAKENED-AWAKEN_FTUE.description:
Playing a Power fills this meter.
Play [blue]7[/blue] Powers to [gold]Awaken[/gold] this combat.
Once [gold]Awakened[/gold], all your Spell cards are [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
